data.name: Ruby
data.gender_notes: Ruby is used as a female name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Latin ruber, 'red', via the gemstone name. Its root is Latin ruber. A modern English given name. Ruby is a Latin name meaning “Red gemstone”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Ruby expresses “Red gemstone”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Latin ruber, 'red', via the gemstone name.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ruby total 21, reducing to 3. Number 3 is associated with expression, creativity and optimism.
